        On June 5, 2026, the Administrative Law Judges (“ALJs”) filed SOAH Order No. 30, in-
cluding Attachment A, which listed the “exhibits that were uploaded into Kiteworks and constitute
either (1) direct, rebuttal, or cross-rebuttal testimony that was prefiled as required by previous
orders, subject to any rulings that have been made to objections; and (2) discovery responses that
were filed in this proceeding.” 1 And at the prehearing conference later that day, the ALJs directed
the parties to file corrections to Attachment A on the Public Utility Commission of Texas’s Inter-
change in Docket No. 59475.
        The M31, M32, and M33 Opposition Landowners (designated as intervenor no. 631 in
Attachment B) timely filed the following nine exhibits around midday on June 3, 2026, on Egnyte
and Kiteworks. 2
